# v10 is live: which version of the Multiverse was your favorite?
The launcher now lets anyone play every milestone of GitHub Multiverse, from v1 (the first walkable universe, Oct 11) to v10 (Squid Game world and the launcher). Open the Home tab, pick a card and press LAUNCH GAME.

Which version did you like most, and what do you miss from the older builds? Tell us here.
